100: A village boy from Menoufia becomes president, goes to war, makes peace, and is shot at a military parade.
The psychiatrist with the tattoo problem is back, and this time a woman in the women's ward says she knows him.
Three half-brothers, born on the same day to three different mothers, get sent back in time to the day their dad met all three.
Samir w Shahir w Baheer (سمير وشهير وبهير)
A village teacher with a stick almost as tall as he is moves to a posh private school, tries to keep the students away from a pop star, and falls for her himself.
Ramadan Mabrouk Abul-Alamein Hamouda (رمضان مبروك أبو العلمين حمودة)
An overprotective dad tries everything to get rid of his only daughter's fiancé, who happens to be a police officer. Basically Meet the Parents.
Aris Min Geha Amneya (عريس من جهة أمنية)
A footballer goes to prison for running over a policeman and builds a football team out of the inmates.
200: A police officer goes home to Upper Egypt and takes on a ruthless local businessman nicknamed after a European dictator.
A boy from a Sharqia village with a bad liver grows up to be the voice of a generation; the lead actor died before filming ended.
A minister takes on a village guy as his servant, and soon the servant is acting more like the minister than the minister.
El Wad Mahrous Btaa El Wazir (الواد محروس بتاع الوزير)
A women's prison guard ends up as an inmate in the same prison.
A prosecutor questions students arrested after a campus militia parade, and the story keeps cutting back to a 1920s schoolteacher starting a movement.
A widow takes her late husband's fishing boat out to sea herself so his family can't take control of her kids' inheritance.
300: The devil moves in with a family, claiming to be their dad's old friend, and tempts them one by one.
Two young men raised in an orphanage try to break free of the man who runs it, who has been using the orphans for his own business.
A retired Egyptian officer puts together a team of young men to rob a bank in Israel.
Ferqet Naji Atallah (فرقة ناجي عطا الله) (TV)
A businessman drowning in bank loans falls for a businesswoman who is drowning in them too.
Three women from very different backgrounds fight back against harassment, and one of them brings a sharp pin on the bus.
The girl who came first in the whole country in Thanaweya Amma knows every textbook by heart and nothing about people, so three different men take turns fooling her.
400: A woman born on the day of the 1952 revolution lives through 60 years of Egyptian history, mostly in queues and government offices.
A suicidal foreigner discovers Sufism and settles in a village in Upper Egypt.
Al Khawaga Abdel Kader (الخواجة عبد القادر) (TV)
A theatre troupe starts rehearsing a new play and realises it exposes their own secrets and crimes.
In the 1890s, an officer who backed the losing side of a revolt is punished with a posting to the Siwa Oasis.
A scientist comes home from abroad and a jinn falls in love with her, and he does not take no for an answer.
A villager is sent to Cairo with the whole village's money to buy a plough, and a pickpocket gets to it first.
Ragab Fawq Safih Sakhin (رجب فوق صفيح ساخن)
500: A magician at a kid's birthday party turns the dad into a chicken, and the mum has to keep the family going.
A village mayor's son is called up for the army, so the mayor sends a poor farmer's son in his place; the stand-in dies in the 1973 war.
A sailor is betrayed by his friends and locked away for years, escapes, finds a treasure, and returns as a rich prince to take revenge.
A grown woman dresses up as a little girl to land a job on a children's TV show, and the man in charge falls for her.
Saghira Ala El Hob (صغيرة على الحب)
A girl from an old Cairo alley wants a better life, so she leaves her fiancé and ends up entertaining British soldiers in World War II.
A thief gets out of prison wanting revenge on his wife and the friend who betrayed him, and keeps shooting the wrong people.
